Both are newspaper tallies, so agreement shows the parse is faithful, not that either is official. Siasat, 18 Dec 2025 (article above): Congress-backed 6,822 (53.60%), BRS 3,519, BJP-backed 703, independents and others 1,654.

2025 names are Telugu, 2019 names Latin, so a raw exact match is 0 by construction. After rule-based Telugu->Latin transliteration (indic-transliteration, HK scheme): exact folded match within the same district name 22.2%; loose match (vowel length, aspiration, v/w, s/sh collapsed) within district 67.7%; loose match anywhere in the state 72.8%; loose match against a different district's 2019 names (chance benchmark) 4.3%. Districts are compared as groups that absorb renames and splits (Mulugu and Narayanpet were carved out in Feb 2019 and the 2019 listing files them under their parents; Hanumakonda and Warangal swapped mandals in 2021). Mandals are not used: 2025 mandal names are Telugu and several mandals were created after 2019. Unmatched district groups: ['Medchal-Malkajgiri'].
